clearance_basis: Operator: the whole path is clear; all 15 marked poses plus 10 cm in all directions are allowed.
path_definition: 100 mm vertical departure/arrival guide points blended into one continuous curve with vertical endpoint tangents. Guide points are control points, not stop points; corners are rounded within the workspace bounds.
signal_processing_note: Analytically bounded joint trajectories use libfranka joint-position rate limiting to handle command discontinuities after lost cycles; no additional low-pass filter. Cartesian legacy execution remains retired. Robot protective limits and live guards remain active.
timing_note: Nominal T=10*(straight_distance/workspace_diagonal)^(1/3); actual duration is the maximum of nominal time, minimum time and bounded arc/orientation derivative requirements.
joint_velocity_cap_source: Operator explicitly requested a 1 rad/s speed cap.
workspace_ceiling_source: Operator explicitly requested a 500 mm height ceiling.

singularity_avoidance.margin_basis: Full and fixed-elbow Jacobian conditioning using the connected robot model. Joint-2 angle/sign alone is not a singularity test; the previous blanket 15-degree exclusion falsely rejected demonstrated poses. Engineering margins are not published Desk warning thresholds.

singularity_execution_note: All normal moves and small jogs require whole-path model preflight and live measured/commanded Jacobian guards; legacy execution retired. These are engineering margins, not a guarantee about proprietary Desk advisory thresholds.
callback_gap_limit_source: Operator explicitly requested a 20 ms callback limit during the layer-9 traversal.

gripper.width_source: Operator: approach with 20 mm opening; set 14 mm to close.
gripper.physical_validation: 20 mm approach/release and 14 mm commanded position closing tested on a_0_0_9 and a_5_4_9. Object contact stopped at about 15.2 mm; both one-brick transfers to pose #1 and releases were camera-verified. No force-grasp command used.
gripper.hold_basis: Operator explicitly confirmed that position control to 14 mm is sufficient to hold the LEGO brick; verify pickup visually.
gripper.close_verification_basis: Command target remains 14 mm using position control. Object contact may stop wider; accept up to nominal 15.8 mm brick width plus 1 mm tolerance, then verify the picked object visually. Operator explicitly accepted the observed 15.2 mm contact width.
